record.paper_title: Open problems on classical de Sitter solutions
record.context_brief: Parallel-source de Sitter solutions in type II supergravity
record.original_question: Do there exist classical de Sitter solutions of 10-dimensional type II supergravity with Op/Dp sources when all sources are parallel and one restricts to the standard smeared ansatz of a 4-dimensional de Sitter spacetime times a compact 6-dimensional group manifold with constant fluxes, or can one prove that no such solution exists?

evidence.quote: In this paper, we stick to the common ansatz of smeared solutions on group manifolds with constant fluxes; (dis)proving the following conjectures for it is a well-defined question.
Conjecture 1 There is no classical de Sitter solution with parallel sources.
But there is also no proof of this conjecture, despite important constraints on such solutions, summarized e.g. in the introduction of [39].

artifact.category_tag: Classical de Sitter solutions in supergravity
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture that no classical de Sitter solution exists with parallel Op/Dp sources in this setting remains open. Subsequent work (e.g., Andriot et al., 2019–2024) has tightened constraints—completely excluding p = 3, 7, 8 and severely constraining p = 4, 5, 6—and no counterexample is known, but a complete proof for all parallel-source cases has not been established.

status_evidence.title: New Constraints on Classical de Sitter: Flirting with the Swampland
status_evidence.snippet: Vacua with parallel and backreacted Op-planes and Dp-branes on dS_4 × M_6: p = 3, 7, 8 are completely excluded; tight constraints for p = 4, 5, 6.
status_evidence.claim: Partial no-go results for parallel-source de Sitter exist, but the conjecture is not fully proved.

status_evidence.title: Almost classical de Sitter?
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2024) exploration of near-solutions and parametric control in classical de Sitter setups.
status_evidence.claim: Active research continues without a complete proof or counterexample for the parallel-sources conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Open problems on classical de Sitter solutions
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture 1: There is no classical de Sitter solution with parallel sources. No proof is known.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture was explicitly stated as open.
